thread:
anya: FYI seeing sudden spike of tiny-gpu evictions in ap-southeast1 around 08:10 UTC — ~1.8k preempts in 30m, mostly short training jobs.
anya: Affected nodes concentrated in az=apse1-b.

sam: pulling graphs. evict heatmap points to apse1-b racks (nodes 07/08/09/14). Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/evict/evict-heat
sam: note: recent scheduler rollout tweaked topology/fragmentation weights last week. could change packing behavior.

maria: scheduler log excerpt:
```text
I03/21 08:12:43 scheduler.go:523] preempt: chosen victim pod=training-mini-123 node=gpu-node-07 scoreDelta=22 reason=taint(packed=true:NoSchedule)
I03/21 08:12:44 kubelet.go:321] eviction: pod training-mini-123, reclaimed resources=0.5cpu 1Gi
```

tim: pods tolerated packed=true but kubelet evicted them — implies node-level pressure (conntrack/disk) created NoExecute taint and warm-pool got drained.

opsbot: alert: 1800 evictions in 30m across ap-southeast1 (nodes: 07,08,09,14) :warning:
eviction-bot: breakdown: conntrack 55%, memory-swap 30%, kube-probe-fail 15%.

maria: confirmed root pattern: conntrack table fills, node gets `node.k8s.io/conntrack-full:NoExecute`, warm-pool controller drains, scheduler repacks and amplifies churn.

sam: recall we lowered spreadPriority and raised fragmentationPenalty last week to pack more tightly. On flaky racks that increases thrash.

anya: immediate mitigations proposed:
- roll back scheduler sensitivity for ap-southeast (sam)
- disable warm-pool auto-drain briefl y for apse1-b (maria)
- conservative repack to move small batch of pods to apse1-a/c (tim)
- bump conntrack sysctls as stopgap (ops)

sam: I can patch configmap to set `fragmentationPenalty` 0.6 -> 0.4 for apse1 region. Patch command: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"fragmentationPenalty":"0.4"}}'`

maria: will add `--min-dont-drain-count=10` to warm-pool controller for apse1-b and `--evictionGrace=60s` so very short jobs survive transient pressure.

tim: repack plan: `repacker:v3` with `--batch-size=50 --prefer-az=apse1-a,apse1-c` filtering `req.gpu==1 && life<5m`. Dry-run first. Command:
```bash
kubectl run repacker-v3 --image=infra/repacker:latest -- /bin/repack --batch-size=50 --filter 'req.gpu==1 && life<5m' --dest-az 'apse1-a,apse1-c'
```

opsbot: warning: repacking will spike scheduling/egress; est cost +~3% tokens/hr during window.

anya: longer-term we need scheduler hooks to weight node health metrics (conntrack_fill) to avoid placing onto conntrack-hot nodes. Add to roadmap.

sam: short-term rollback in progress. will monitor metrics for 15m.

maria: warm-pool canary applied to apse1-b-pool-2 with min-dont-drain-count=10.
tim: repacker dry-run complete and safe; waiting on final go.

anya: plan of record: sam rollback, maria warm-pool patch, tim standby repack, ops monitor and increase net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on worst nodes if needed. escalate if >200 evictions/5m persists. :eyes:

sam: rollback finished — scheduler configmap updated. monitoring: https://grafana/redwood/d/evict/evict-heat?var-region=apse1

maria: warm-pool canary rolled to apse1-b small pool.
tim: standing by for repack exec.

anya: update in 15, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
